name: overlays/tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A short label on hover and focus that you can dismiss.

files.content:
export { Tooltip } from './Tooltip';
export type { TooltipProps } from './Tooltip';

keyboard.action: Focus the trigger: the tooltip appears at once.
Hide the tooltip without moving focus.

notes: The tooltip has `role="tooltip"` and describes its trigger through `aria-describedby`, so its text is read after the trigger’s name.
It shows on keyboard focus (not on mouse focus), and on hover after a short delay.
A 100 ms grace period lets the pointer cross from the trigger onto the tooltip.
It is never shown for touch input, where hover does not exist.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The tooltip appears without its short rise.
